ex.en: Hello, would you like to sit next to me?
ex.zh: 你好，你愿意坐在我旁边吗？

ex.en: A simple hello between neighbours can encourage social contact and help newcomers feel welcome in a community.
ex.zh: 邻里之间一句简单的问候就能促进交往，让新来者感受到社区的欢迎。

tip: 电话开头的hello可译为“喂”；say hello to表示向某人问好。

senses.en: used as a friendly greeting when you meet someone

ex.en: Hi, Amy! I am so happy to see you today.
ex.zh: 嗨，艾米！我今天见到你真开心。

ex.en: Every morning at the school gate, students smile and say hi to teachers.
ex.zh: 每天早上在校门口，同学们都会微笑着向老师问好。

tip: “hi”比“hello”更口语化，常用于熟人或同龄人打招呼。

senses.en: used to say farewell when you leave someone

ex.en: Goodbye, Mom! I am going to school with Tom.
ex.zh: 再见，妈妈！我要和汤姆一起去上学了。

ex.en: When the afternoon bell rings, the children pack their bags and wave goodbye.
ex.zh: 下午放学铃响时，孩子们收拾好书包挥手告别。

tip: 告别时除了“goodbye”，还可以用更简短亲切的“bye”。

ex.en: I open the curtains every morning and water my plants.
ex.zh: 我每天早晨拉开窗帘，给植物浇水。

ex.en: Schools that start later in the morning may help teenagers get enough sleep and concentrate better.
ex.zh: 上午较晚上课的学校可能有助于青少年获得充足睡眠，更好地集中注意力。

col: in the morning｜在早晨；在上午
on Monday morning｜在星期一早上
tip: 泛指用in the morning；具体某天早上用on。

ex.en: We spent the afternoon baking bread in the kitchen.
ex.zh: 我们整个下午都在厨房里烤面包。

ex.en: Schools could offer afternoon sports sessions to help students develop healthier habits and stronger friendships.
ex.zh: 学校可以在下午安排体育活动，帮助学生养成更健康的习惯并增进友谊。

tip: 泛指下午用in；具体某天下午用on。

senses.en: used by the speaker to refer to himself or herself

ex.en: I like eating sweet red apples after my lunch.
ex.zh: 我喜欢在午饭后吃又红又甜的苹果。

ex.en: Every Friday afternoon, I water the small green plants in our classroom corner.
ex.zh: 每周五下午，我都会给教室角落里的绿色小植物浇水。

tip: 人称代词“I”无论放在句首还是句中，都必须永远大写。

senses.en: the form of the verb "be" used after "I"

ex.en: I am seven years old and in Grade One.
ex.zh: 我今年七岁了，在读一年级。

ex.en: I am very proud to help my classmates clean the science room.
ex.zh: 我很自豪能帮同学们一起打扫科学教室。

col: I am a student.｜我是一名学生。
tip: “am”只和主语“I”搭配使用，在口语中常缩写为“I'm”。

senses.en: a common English first name for a boy or man

ex.en: Danny is my good friend and he plays football well.
ex.zh: 丹尼是我的好朋友，他踢足球踢得很好。

ex.en: During our nature walk, Danny found a bright yellow leaf near trees.
ex.zh: 在自然漫步活动时，丹尼在树旁发现了一片亮黄色的树叶。

col: My name is Danny.｜我叫丹尼。
tip: 英文人名是专有名词，首字母“D”在任何位置都要大写。

senses.en: a common English first name for a girl or woman

ex.en: Kitty has a pink schoolbag and two cute blue pencils.
ex.zh: 凯蒂有一个粉红色的书包和两支可爱的蓝色铅笔。

ex.en: In art class today, Kitty drew a happy brown dog on white paper.
ex.zh: 今天的美术课上，凯蒂在白纸上画了一只快乐的棕色小狗。

tip: “Kitty”作为女生英文名时首字母要大写，小写时可指小猫。

senses.en: a common English first name for a boy or man

ex.en: Eddie likes reading funny picture books in his warm room.
ex.zh: 艾迪喜欢在温暖的房间里看有趣的图画书。

ex.en: After school on Tuesday, Eddie helps clean the desks in the music room.
ex.zh: 周二放学后，艾迪帮忙清理音乐教室里的桌子。

tip: 注意“Eddie”中间是双写字母“dd”，拼写时别漏掉一个。

senses.en: a common English first name for a girl or woman

ex.en: Alice sings sweet songs with her friends in the park.
ex.zh: 爱丽丝和她的朋友们在公园里唱甜美的歌。

ex.en: Alice loves watching colorful butterflies fly around the flowers in our school garden.
ex.zh: 爱丽丝喜欢看五颜六色的蝴蝶在学校花园的花丛间飞舞。

col: Nice to meet you, Alice.｜很高兴认识你，爱丽丝。
tip: “Alice”是常见女生英文名，注意末尾的字母“e”不发音。

ex.en: We walk to school together along the river.
ex.zh: 我们一起沿着河边步行上学。

ex.en: Every school should provide opportunities for students to develop practical skills alongside their academic knowledge.
ex.zh: 每所学校都应提供机会，让学生在学习学科知识的同时培养实践技能。

tip: go to school指上学；go to the school指去校址。

ex.en: We spent the whole day building sandcastles on the beach.
ex.zh: 我们一整天都在海滩上堆沙堡。

ex.en: Shorter working days may improve employee wellbeing while allowing parents to spend more time with their children.
ex.zh: 缩短每日工作时间可能改善员工的身心状态，同时让家长有更多时间陪伴孩子。

tip: every day意为每天；everyday是形容词，意为日常的。

senses.en: a common English first name for a boy or man

ex.en: Peter rides his red bike to the park every Sunday.
ex.zh: 彼得每个星期天都骑着他的红色自行车去公园。

ex.en: In our science group, Peter carefully records how tall the bean plant grows.
ex.zh: 在我们的科学小组里，彼得认真记录豆苗长高了多少。

tip: “Peter”首字母要大写，英式发音末尾不卷舌，美式会卷舌。

senses.en: a common English first name for a boy or man

ex.en: John is very tall and likes playing basketball after school.
ex.zh: 约翰很高，他喜欢在放学后打篮球。

ex.en: Last week, John shared an interesting story about Chinese lanterns in class.
ex.zh: 上周，约翰在课堂上分享了一个关于中国灯笼的有趣故事。

tip: “John”里的字母“h”不发音，拼读和默写时要注意记住它。

senses.en: a common English first name for a girl or woman

ex.en: Linda wears a clean white dress to school this morning.
ex.zh: 琳达今天早上穿了一条干净的白色连衣裙去上学。

ex.en: Linda and her classmates planted three young trees on the hill last spring.
ex.zh: 去年春天，琳达和同学们在山坡上种了三棵小树苗。

tip: “Linda”重音在第一音节，拼写按音节分“Lin-da”很好记。

senses.en: a common English first name for a boy or man

ex.en: Tom has a cute white cat that sleeps all day.
ex.zh: 汤姆有一只可爱的白猫，它整天都在睡觉。

ex.en: Tom enjoys reading maps and learning about big rivers during geography club time.
ex.zh: 汤姆喜欢在地理社团时间看地图并了解大江大河。

tip: “Tom”只有三个字母，注意作为人名时首字母“T”必须大写。

ex.en: We spent the evening cooking and listening to music.
ex.zh: 我们做饭、听音乐，度过了这个晚上。

ex.en: Evening classes allow working adults to gain new qualifications without giving up their current employment.
ex.zh: 晚间课程让在职成年人无需辞去现有工作，也能获得新的资格证书。

tip: 泛指晚上用in the evening；this evening前不加介词。

ex.en: We watched the stars from our balcony last night.
ex.zh: 昨晚，我们在阳台上看星星。

ex.en: Excessive artificial light at night can disrupt sleep patterns and affect the behaviour of urban wildlife.
ex.zh: 夜间过多的人造光会扰乱睡眠规律，并影响城市野生动物的行为。

col: a good night's sleep｜一夜好眠
tip: 泛指夜间用at night；last night前不加介词。

ex.en: Please give your sister a clean towel after swimming.
ex.zh: 游泳后请给你妹妹一条干净的毛巾。

ex.en: Schools should give students opportunities to develop practical skills through projects that address real community needs.
ex.zh: 学校应通过解决社区实际需求的项目，让学生有机会培养实践技能。

col: give someone a chance｜给某人机会
tip: give sb sth＝give sth to sb；过去式gave。

senses.en: the object form of "I", used after a verb or preposition

ex.en: Please give me that blue ruler on your desk.
ex.zh: 请把你桌子上的那把蓝色尺子递给我。

ex.en: My science teacher asked me to hold the glass bottle during the experiment.
ex.zh: 我的科学老师让我在做实验时拿住那个玻璃瓶。

tip: “me”和“I”都表示“我”，但“me”通常用在动词或介词后面。

senses.en: to tell someone that you are grateful for something

ex.en: Thank you for helping me carry these heavy books.
ex.zh: 谢谢你帮我搬这些沉重的书。

ex.en: We should thank the farmers who grow fresh rice and vegetables for us.
ex.zh: 我们应该感谢为我们种植新鲜大米和蔬菜的农民伯伯。

tip: 发“th”音时舌尖轻触上下齿，常见礼貌表达为“Thank you”。

senses.en: the person or people that someone is talking or writing to

ex.en: Can you show me how to draw a star?
ex.zh: 你能教我怎么画一颗星星吗？

ex.en: If you listen closely in the forest, you can hear happy birds singing.
ex.zh: 如果你在森林里仔细听，就能听见快乐的小鸟在唱歌。

tip: “you”既可以指“你”也可以指“你们”，后面都搭配“are”使用。

ex.en: Could you please hold the door for me?
ex.zh: 你能帮我扶一下门吗？

ex.en: Public policies designed to please every group may fail to address the most urgent social problems.
ex.zh: 旨在取悦所有群体的公共政策，可能无法解决最紧迫的社会问题。

tip: please是动词；感到满意用be pleased。

senses.en: used before a singular noun starting with a consonant sound meaning one

ex.en: I see a small yellow bird on the tree.
ex.zh: 我看见树上有一只黄色的小鸟。

ex.en: Our teacher brought a bright magnifying glass to observe tiny green leaves.
ex.zh: 我们老师带了一个亮晶晶的放大镜来观察细小的绿叶。

tip: “a”用于辅音音素开头的可数名词单数前，元音音素前改用“an”。

ex.en: I left my book on the kitchen table.
ex.zh: 我把书落在厨房的桌子上了。

ex.en: Public libraries provide free access to books, helping people continue learning regardless of their income.
ex.zh: 公共图书馆提供免费借阅书籍的机会，让不同收入的人都能持续学习。

tip: book 作动词表示预订，可直接接房间、机票等。

ex.en: Use a ruler to draw a straight line here.
ex.zh: 用尺子在这里画一条直线。

ex.en: The decisions of ancient rulers often influenced trade, architecture, and the daily lives of ordinary people.
ex.zh: 古代统治者的决策往往影响贸易、建筑以及普通人的日常生活。

col: measure with a ruler｜用尺子测量
tip: a ruler可指一把尺子或一位统治者，需看语境。

ex.en: She sharpened her pencil before sketching the sleeping cat.
ex.zh: 她削好铅笔，开始画那只熟睡的猫。

ex.en: Using a pencil allows students to revise diagrams easily as their understanding of scientific concepts develops.
ex.zh: 使用铅笔让学生能随着对科学概念理解的加深，轻松修改图示。

tip: 用铅笔写说in pencil；pencil in指暂定安排。

senses.en: a small object used to rub out pencil marks from paper

ex.en: May I borrow your white rubber for a minute?
ex.zh: 我可以借用一下你的白色橡皮吗？

ex.en: When you make a mistake in drawing, use a soft rubber to clean it.
ex.zh: 画画出错的时候，可以用柔软的橡皮把它擦干净。

tip: “rubber”是英式常用词，指文具“橡皮”，美式常说“eraser”。

senses.en: a stick of colored wax used for drawing or coloring

ex.en: I color the bright sun with my orange crayon.
ex.zh: 我用我的橙色蜡笔给明亮的太阳涂色。

ex.en: Our art teacher gave every student a new box of twelve colorful crayons.
ex.zh: 美术老师给每位同学发了一盒全新的十二色彩色蜡笔。

col: a box of crayons｜一盒蜡笔
color with a crayon｜用蜡笔涂色
tip: “crayon”是可数名词，说“一盒蜡笔”时要加上复数“crayons”。

ex.en: Could you lend me a pen for this form?
ex.zh: 你能借我一支笔填这张表吗？

ex.en: Some students prefer using a pen because writing by hand helps them organise their ideas.
ex.zh: 有些学生更喜欢用笔，因为手写有助于他们整理思路。

tip: pen泛指墨水笔；钢笔可明确说fountain pen。

ex.en: She keeps a small notebook beside her bed.
ex.zh: 她在床边放着一本小笔记本。

ex.en: Keeping a notebook during fieldwork allows researchers to record observations that photographs alone may not capture.
ex.zh: 实地研究时使用笔记本，有助于研究人员记录仅靠照片可能无法捕捉的观察结果。

col: write in a notebook｜在笔记本上写
a spiral notebook｜螺旋装订笔记本
tip: 通常指纸质笔记本；电脑义也可说notebook computer。

senses.en: used to express surprise or strong feeling about a quality

ex.en: Look at the baby panda! How cute it is!
ex.zh: 快看那只熊猫宝宝！它多么可爱啊！

ex.en: How bright and colorful the lantern festival looks in the evening sky!
ex.zh: 夜空下的元宵灯会看起来多么明亮、多么绚丽啊！

tip: “How + 形容词”构成感叹句，表示“多么……啊”，句尾常加感叹号。

ex.en: We had a nice picnic beside the lake.
ex.zh: 我们在湖边愉快地野餐了一次。

ex.en: Although nice surroundings matter, affordable housing and reliable transport are more important to many urban residents.
ex.zh: 虽然宜人的环境很重要，但对许多城市居民而言，可负担的住房和可靠的交通更为重要。

col: be nice to someone｜友善地对待某人
tip: nice含义较宽，正式写作宜换成更具体的形容词。

ex.en: I can see a rainbow above the trees.
ex.zh: 我能看见树梢上方有一道彩虹。

ex.en: When students see how science applies to everyday life, they often become more interested in learning.
ex.zh: 当学生理解科学如何应用于日常生活时，他们往往会对学习更感兴趣。

col: see someone's point｜理解某人的意思
tip: 过去式saw，过去分词seen；强调看见而非观看。

ex.en: My classmate lent me a pencil before the lesson.
ex.zh: 上课前，我的同班同学借给我一支铅笔。

ex.en: Working with classmates on group projects can help students develop communication and problem-solving skills.
ex.zh: 与同班同学合作完成小组项目可以帮助学生培养沟通和解决问题的能力。

col: a former classmate｜以前的同班同学
help a classmate｜帮助同班同学
tip: classmate指同班同学，schoolmate指同校同学。

ex.en: We usually cook a big lunch together on Sunday.
ex.zh: 我们通常在星期日一起做一顿丰盛的午餐。

ex.en: Opening public libraries on Sunday allows people with busy weekday schedules to access essential community services.
ex.zh: 公共图书馆星期日开放，让工作日忙碌的人也能享用重要的社区服务。

tip: 星期名称首字母大写；on Sunday，但next Sunday不用on。

ex.en: He washed his face before sitting down for breakfast.
ex.zh: 他洗了脸才坐下来吃早餐。

ex.en: Many coastal cities face increasing risks from flooding as sea levels rise and extreme weather becomes more frequent.
ex.zh: 随着海平面上升和极端天气日益频繁，许多沿海城市面临越来越大的洪水风险。

tip: 面对困难可说face difficulties或be faced with difficulties。

ex.en: The dentist asked me to open my mouth wider.
ex.zh: 牙医让我把嘴张大一点。

ex.en: Wetlands near the mouth of a river provide valuable habitats and help protect coastal communities from flooding.
ex.zh: 河口附近的湿地提供了宝贵的栖息地，也有助于保护沿海社区免遭洪灾。

col: the mouth of a river｜河口
tip: 名词末音为/θ/；动词末音为/ð/。

ex.en: My nose turned red in the cold wind.
ex.zh: 我的鼻子在冷风中冻红了。

ex.en: Wearing a mask over the nose and mouth can reduce exposure to airborne dust.
ex.zh: 戴口罩遮住口鼻可以减少吸入空气中的灰尘。

col: the nose of an aircraft｜飞机机头
tip: 擤鼻涕用blow your nose，不用clean。

ex.en: She closed her eyes and listened to the rain.
ex.zh: 她闭上眼睛，听着雨声。

ex.en: Designers need an eye for detail to create public spaces that are both attractive and accessible.
ex.zh: 设计师需要善于观察细节，才能打造既美观又便于所有人使用的公共空间。

col: keep an eye on｜留意；照看
an eye for detail｜对细节的敏锐观察力
catch someone's eye｜引起某人的注意
tip: an eye for表示鉴赏力；keep an eye on表示照看。

ex.en: My ears felt cold, so I pulled on a hat.
ex.zh: 我的耳朵觉得冷，于是我戴上了帽子。

ex.en: Regular exposure to loud music can damage the ears and lead to permanent hearing loss.
ex.zh: 经常接触高音量音乐可能损伤耳朵，并导致永久性听力损失。

col: an ear for music｜音乐辨音能力
an ear of wheat｜一穗小麦
tip: have an ear for表示善于辨听音乐、语言等。

ex.en: She shook her head when I offered more soup.
ex.zh: 我问她要不要再来点汤，她摇了摇头。

ex.en: Cyclists should wear suitable helmets to reduce the risk of head injuries when travelling on busy roads.
ex.zh: 骑车人在繁忙道路上行驶时应佩戴合适的头盔，以降低头部受伤的风险。

tip: head for＋地点表示“朝某地去”。

ex.en: She held the warm cup in her left hand.
ex.zh: 她用左手握着温热的杯子。

ex.en: Practical workshops allow students to develop skills by making objects with their own hands.
ex.zh: 实践工作坊让学生通过亲手制作物品来培养技能。

col: give someone a hand｜帮某人一把
hand in an assignment｜提交作业
tip: give someone a hand表示帮忙；by hand表示手工。

ex.en: She carried the sleeping baby gently in her arms.
ex.zh: 她轻轻地把熟睡的宝宝抱在怀里。

ex.en: Schools should arm students with practical skills that help them adapt to a rapidly changing workplace.
ex.zh: 学校应让学生掌握实用技能，帮助他们适应快速变化的职场。

col: arm someone with knowledge｜用知识充实某人
tip: 表“武器”用复数arms；arm还可作动词。

ex.en: My legs felt tired after the long walk home.
ex.zh: 走了很长一段路回家后，我的双腿很累。

ex.en: Regular walking strengthens the muscles in our legs and can improve health without expensive equipment.
ex.zh: 经常步行能增强腿部肌肉，无需昂贵器材就能改善健康。

col: stretch your legs｜活动一下腿脚
the final leg of a journey｜旅程的最后一段
tip: leg也指桌椅的支脚或旅程中的一段。

ex.en: I left my umbrella beside the front door.
ex.zh: 我把我的伞放在前门旁边了。

ex.en: In my view, cities should prioritise affordable housing rather than invest heavily in prestigious construction projects.
ex.zh: 在我看来，城市应优先提供可负担住房，而非大量投资于彰显声望的建设项目。

col: to my surprise｜令我惊讶的是
tip: my后须接名词；mine可独立使用，表示“我的”。

ex.en: Please leave your shoes by the door before entering.
ex.zh: 进来前请把你的鞋放在门边。

ex.en: Choosing a university near your home can reduce living expenses and make higher education more affordable.
ex.zh: 选择离家近的大学可以减少生活开支，让高等教育更负担得起。

col: do your best｜尽你最大的努力
tip: your后接名词；yours独立使用；you're意为你是。

ex.en: Look at the tiny bird beside the window.
ex.zh: 看窗边那只小鸟。

ex.en: Public parks often look more attractive when local residents help maintain their gardens and pathways.
ex.zh: 当当地居民协助维护花园和步道时，公共公园往往显得更有吸引力。

tip: look at后接看的对象；look作系动词后接形容词。

senses.en: to own, hold, or possess something

ex.en: I have two big eyes and a small nose.
ex.zh: 我有两只大眼睛和一个小鼻子。

ex.en: We have a lively music class every Wednesday morning in the big hall.
ex.zh: 每周三上午我们在大礼堂里有一节热闹的音乐课。

tip: 主语是“I/you/we/they”时用“have”，第三人称单数要变成“has”。

ex.en: Please don't touch the pan; it is still hot.
ex.zh: 请别碰锅，它还很烫。

ex.en: Digital communication helps families stay in touch, even when work or study separates them across countries.
ex.zh: 即使工作或学习使家人分居不同国家，数字通信也能帮助他们保持联系。

tip: 保持联系用keep in touch with someone。

ex.en: We need a big bag for all these towels.
ex.zh: 我们需要一个大袋子来装所有这些毛巾。

ex.en: Public transport can make a big difference to air quality in rapidly growing cities.
ex.zh: 公共交通能显著改善快速发展城市的空气质量。

tip: big较口语；正式写作可按语境用large或major。

ex.en: Our small kitchen has room for only two chairs.
ex.zh: 我们的小厨房只能放下两把椅子。

ex.en: Even small improvements in home insulation can reduce energy consumption and lower household bills.
ex.zh: 即使对住宅保温做出小幅改善，也能减少能源消耗并降低家庭开支。

tip: 数量少可说a small number of，不能说small people。

ex.en: That cute kitten is sleeping inside my slipper.
ex.zh: 那只可爱的小猫正睡在我的拖鞋里。

ex.en: Advertisements often feature cute animals to attract attention and create positive feelings towards a product.
ex.zh: 广告常用可爱的动物吸引注意，让人们对产品产生好感。

tip: 偏口语，常形容婴儿、小动物或讨喜的外表。

senses.en: used to make a verb or statement negative

ex.en: This green bag is not mine; it is Tom's.
ex.zh: 这个绿色的书包不是我的，它是汤姆的。

ex.en: A whale lives in the deep ocean, and it is not a fish.
ex.zh: 鲸鱼生活在深海里，而且它不是鱼类。

tip: “not”放在“be”动词后面表否定，“is not”常缩写为“isn't”。

senses.en: used to give a negative answer or say something is not true

ex.en: No, thank you! I already have water in my bottle.
ex.zh: 不了，谢谢你！我的水壶里已经有水了。

ex.en: No, a penguin cannot fly in the sky, though it has wings.
ex.zh: 不，企鹅虽然有翅膀，但它不能在天空中飞翔。

col: No, I am not.｜不，我不是。
tip: 回答一般疑问句时，“No”后面要加逗号，再接完整的否定回答。

ex.en: She hung a picture of the sea above her bed.
ex.zh: 她在床头上方挂了一幅海景画。

ex.en: Survey results provide a clearer picture of how housing costs affect the wellbeing of young adults.
ex.zh: 调查结果更清楚地呈现了住房成本如何影响年轻成年人的幸福感。

col: picture yourself doing something｜想象自己做某事
tip: take a picture是拍照；draw a picture是画画。

senses.en: a common English first name for a boy or man

ex.en: Jack likes playing chess with his grandpa after dinner.
ex.zh: 杰克喜欢在晚饭后和爷爷下棋。

ex.en: In our reading corner, Jack shared a storybook about a brave sailor.
ex.zh: 在我们的读书角，杰克分享了一本关于勇敢水手的故事书。

col: Jack is my friend.｜杰克是我的朋友。
tip: “Jack”中“ck”发清脆的/k/音，作为男名首字母“J”要大写。

ex.en: I can carry both bags if you open the door.
ex.zh: 你要是把门打开，我就能把两个袋子都提进去。

ex.en: Access to reliable internet can help rural students benefit from a wider range of educational resources.
ex.zh: 稳定的互联网接入能帮助农村学生利用更丰富的教育资源。

tip: 作情态动词后接动词原形，第三人称不加s。

ex.en: We danced in the kitchen while dinner was cooking.
ex.zh: 晚饭还在做的时候，我们在厨房里跳起了舞。

ex.en: Traditional dance can strengthen community identity while offering younger generations a connection to their cultural heritage.
ex.zh: 传统舞蹈能够增强社区认同感，同时让年轻一代与自身文化遗产建立联系。

col: dance to music｜随着音乐跳舞
tip: 随音乐跳舞用dance to music，介词用to。

ex.en: I read a few pages before bed every night.
ex.zh: 我每天晚上睡前都会读几页书。

ex.en: Children who read regularly often develop stronger language skills and a broader understanding of the world.
ex.zh: 经常阅读的儿童通常能培养更强的语言能力，对世界也有更广泛的了解。

tip: 原形读/riːd/；过去式及过去分词读/red/。

ex.en: We sing our favourite songs while washing the dishes.
ex.zh: 我们一边洗碗，一边唱自己最喜欢的歌。

ex.en: Children who sing together regularly may develop greater confidence and stronger relationships with their classmates.
ex.zh: 经常一起唱歌的孩子可能会变得更加自信，与同学的关系也更加紧密。

col: sing in a choir｜在合唱团唱歌
tip: 不规则变化：sing—sang—sung。

ex.en: She drew a sleeping cat in her sketchbook.
ex.zh: 她在素描本上画了一只熟睡的猫。

ex.en: Free cultural events can draw more visitors to museums and encourage wider participation in the arts.
ex.zh: 免费文化活动可以吸引更多人参观博物馆，并鼓励公众更广泛地参与艺术活动。

tip: 过去式drew，过去分词drawn；另可指平局。

senses.en: used in questions to ask for information about something

ex.en: What is inside that colorful gift box on the table?
ex.zh: 桌子上的那个彩色礼盒里面有什么？

ex.en: What do plants need from the sun and rain to grow tall outdoors?
ex.zh: 植物在户外需要从阳光和雨水中获得什么才能长高？

col: What is your name?｜你叫什么名字？
tip: “What”常放在特殊疑问句句首用来提问事物，回答不能用“Yes/No”。

senses.en: to carry out an action, job, or activity

ex.en: I always do my homework carefully before dinner time.
ex.zh: 我总是在晚饭前认真做家庭作业。

ex.en: Every morning, students do simple stretching exercises together on the sunny school playground.
ex.zh: 每天早上，同学们都会在阳光明媚的学校操场上一起做简单的伸展运动。

tip: “do”表示“做某事”，如“do homework”，主语三单时变成“does”。

ex.en: She placed fresh flowers in a vase by the window.
ex.zh: 她把鲜花插进窗边的花瓶里。

ex.en: Planting native flowers in urban parks can support pollinating insects and improve local biodiversity.
ex.zh: 在城市公园种植本地花卉能够帮助传粉昆虫生存，并改善当地生物多样性。

tip: flower既可作名词“花”，也可作动词“开花”。

ex.en: Their house has a small garden behind the kitchen.
ex.zh: 他们的房子在厨房后面有一个小花园。

ex.en: Local authorities could convert unused office buildings into apartments to house families in need of affordable accommodation.
ex.zh: 地方政府可以将闲置办公楼改造成公寓，为需要可负担住房的家庭提供住所。

tip: 名词读/haʊs/，动词读/haʊz/；home更强调家的归属感。

senses.en: to make a picture or cover a surface using colored paint and a brush

ex.en: I like to paint green hills and white clouds.
ex.zh: 我喜欢用颜料绘画绿色的山丘和白色的云朵。

ex.en: During art club, children paint traditional clay masks with bright red brushes.
ex.zh: 在美术社团课上，孩子们用鲜红的画笔为传统泥塑面具上色绘画。

col: paint with a brush｜用画笔绘画
tip: “paint”指用颜料画画或涂色，和用铅笔素描“draw”有所区别。

ex.en: Please write your address on this small card.
ex.zh: 请把你的地址写在这张小卡片上。

ex.en: Students who write regularly often develop stronger reasoning skills and express complex ideas more clearly.
ex.zh: 经常写作的学生往往能培养更强的推理能力，并更清晰地表达复杂观点。

tip: 不规则变化：write—wrote—written。

ex.en: The dog jumped over a puddle beside the gate.
ex.zh: 狗跳过了大门旁的一摊积水。

ex.en: Housing costs have jumped sharply in cities where demand continues to exceed the supply of affordable homes.
ex.zh: 在住房需求持续超过可负担住房供应的城市，住房成本已大幅上涨。

col: jump over a fence｜跳过篱笆
jump at the chance｜欣然抓住机会
a sharp jump in prices｜价格的猛涨
tip: jump at the chance意为欣然抓住机会。

ex.en: We swim in the indoor pool every Saturday morning.
ex.zh: 我们每周六早上都在室内泳池游泳。

ex.en: Schools should teach children to swim because this essential skill improves both physical fitness and water safety.
ex.zh: 学校应教孩子游泳，因为这项基本技能既能增强体能，又能提高水上安全性。

tip: 不规则变化：swim—swam—swum。

ex.en: My family gathers around the kitchen table every Sunday.
ex.zh: 我的家人每周日都会围坐在厨房的餐桌旁。

ex.en: Flexible working hours can help parents balance family responsibilities with the demands of paid employment.
ex.zh: 弹性工作时间可以帮助父母平衡家庭责任与有偿工作的要求。

tip: family作整体用单数；英式英语强调成员时可用复数。

senses.en: used in questions to ask about a person's name or identity

ex.en: Who is that smiling girl standing near the door?
ex.zh: 站在门旁边的那个微笑着的女孩是谁？

ex.en: Who can tell the class the name of this famous Chinese poem?
ex.zh: 谁能告诉全班同学这首著名中国古诗的名字？

tip: “who”专门用来对“人”提问，其中的字母“w”不发音，读作/huː/。

senses.en: used to refer to a boy or man already mentioned

ex.en: He is my older brother and he likes swimming.
ex.zh: 他是我的哥哥，他非常喜欢游泳。

ex.en: My uncle works in a museum, and he knows many ancient dinosaur stories.
ex.zh: 我的叔叔在博物馆工作，他知道许多古老的恐龙故事。

tip: “he”指代男性“他”，是第三人称单数，后面动词要搭配“is”或加“s”。

senses.en: used to refer to a girl or woman already mentioned

ex.en: She is my best friend and she dances well.
ex.zh: 她是我最好的朋友，她跳舞跳得很好。

ex.en: My sister loves nature, so she keeps a diary about garden birds daily.
ex.zh: 我姐姐热爱大自然，所以她每天都写关于花园小鸟的日记。

tip: “she”指代女性“她”，不要和男性的“he”混淆，注意“sh”发音。

ex.en: My grandfather taught me how to grow tomatoes.
ex.zh: 我的祖父教过我如何种番茄。

ex.en: A grandfather who provides regular childcare can strengthen family bonds and support working parents.
ex.zh: 经常帮忙照顾孩子的祖父或外祖父能够增进家庭感情，并为在职父母提供支持。

tip: 不区分父系母系；外祖父可说maternal grandfather。

ex.en: My grandmother grows fresh herbs on her kitchen windowsill.
ex.zh: 我的祖母在厨房窗台上种新鲜的香草。

ex.en: For many working parents, a grandmother provides essential childcare and helps maintain strong family connections.
ex.zh: 对许多在职父母来说，祖母或外祖母提供了不可或缺的育儿帮助，也有助于维系紧密的家庭关系。

tip: 可指祖母或外祖母；口语常用grandma。

ex.en: Her father taught her to ride a bicycle.
ex.zh: 她爸爸教她骑自行车。

ex.en: Flexible working arrangements can allow fathers to take a more active role in raising their children.
ex.zh: 灵活的工作安排可以让父亲更积极地参与养育子女。

col: the father of modern medicine｜现代医学之父
tip: father较正式，dad更口语化；父亲节用Father's Day。

ex.en: My mother taught me how to ride a bicycle.
ex.zh: 我妈妈教会了我骑自行车。

ex.en: Affordable childcare can help a mother return to work without placing excessive pressure on the family budget.
ex.zh: 负担得起的托育服务能帮助母亲重返职场，而不给家庭预算带来过大压力。

tip: 英式口语常用mum，美式口语常用mom。

senses.en: the object form of "I", used after a verb or preposition

ex.en: Please give me that blue ruler on your desk.
ex.zh: 请把你桌子上的那把蓝色尺子递给我。

ex.en: My science teacher asked me to hold the glass bottle during the experiment.
ex.zh: 我的科学老师让我在做实验时拿住那个玻璃瓶。

tip: “me”和“I”都表示“我”，但“me”通常用在动词或介词后面。

ex.en: My uncle taught me how to mend a bicycle.
ex.zh: 我叔叔教过我怎样修自行车。

ex.en: An uncle or aunt can provide valuable emotional support when parents are busy with work commitments.
ex.zh: 父母忙于工作时，叔伯姑姨等亲属可以提供宝贵的情感支持。

col: uncle and aunt｜叔伯姑姨等亲属
tip: uncle不区分父母哪一方，也不区分长幼。

ex.en: My aunt taught me how to bake bread.
ex.zh: 我姨妈教会了我如何烤面包。

ex.en: Extended family members, such as aunts and uncles, often provide valuable childcare support for working parents.
ex.zh: 姑姨叔舅等大家庭成员常为在职父母提供宝贵的育儿支持。

col: aunt and uncle｜姑姨叔舅等亲属
tip: 不区分父系或母系；美音也常读/ɑːnt/。

ex.en: My younger brother borrowed my bicycle this morning.
ex.zh: 我弟弟今天早上借用了我的自行车。

ex.en: Older brothers and sisters can support younger children's learning by reading with them regularly at home.
ex.zh: 哥哥姐姐可以通过经常在家陪弟弟妹妹阅读来帮助他们学习。

tip: brother不区分兄弟；用older或younger说明长幼。

ex.en: My younger sister always borrows my favourite blue jumper.
ex.zh: 我妹妹总是借穿我最喜欢的蓝色毛衣。

ex.en: Children who regularly share responsibilities with a brother or sister may develop stronger cooperation skills at home.
ex.zh: 经常与兄弟姐妹分担责任的孩子，可能会在家中培养出更强的合作能力。

tip: sister不分姐姐妹妹；需用older或younger说明年龄关系。

ex.en: The baby fell asleep while her father sang softly.
ex.zh: 爸爸轻声唱歌时，宝宝睡着了。

ex.en: Affordable childcare helps parents of young babies return to work without placing excessive pressure on family finances.
ex.zh: 负担得起的托育服务有助于婴儿的父母重返工作岗位，而不会给家庭财务带来过大压力。

tip: 复数为babies；baby作动词常含“过度照顾”之意。

ex.en: She wore a silver ring on her middle finger.
ex.zh: 她的中指上戴着一枚银戒指。

ex.en: Tasks requiring precise finger movements can help young children develop coordination before they learn to write.
ex.zh: 需要手指精细动作的任务可以帮助幼儿在学习写字前发展协调能力。

col: point a finger at｜用手指指向；指责
tip: 通常不包括拇指；拇指专称thumb。

senses.en: used to give a positive answer or agree with someone

ex.en: Yes, I am ready to go to school.
ex.zh: 是的，我已经准备好去上学了。

ex.en: Yes, our class will visit the city science museum next Friday morning.
ex.zh: 是的，我们班下周五上午要去参观市科学博物馆。

tip: 用“Yes”做肯定回答时，后面加逗号，且不能用缩写形式结尾。

senses.en: used to ask about or refer to a place or position

ex.en: Where are we going for our family trip?
ex.zh: 我们这次家庭旅行要去哪里？

ex.en: Can you show me on the map where the longest river begins?
ex.zh: 你能在地图上指给我看这条最长的河流是从哪里发源的吗？

tip: “where”用来对地点“哪里”提问，注意里面的字母“h”不发音。

senses.en: having a lot of flesh on the body; plump and round

ex.en: That fat orange cat sleeps softly on the sofa.
ex.zh: 那只胖乎乎的橘猫正在沙发上静静地睡觉。

ex.en: Before winter comes, the fat brown bear eats plenty of sweet berries.
ex.zh: 冬天来临之前，这只胖棕熊会吃很多甜浆果。

col: fat and cute｜胖乎乎又可爱
tip: “fat”指体形“胖的”，反义词是“thin（瘦的）”，形容动物很常见。

senses.en: having little fat on the body; slender

ex.en: The tall giraffe has a very thin, long neck.
ex.zh: 那只高高的长颈鹿有着又瘦又长的脖子。

ex.en: The thin grey monkey climbs quickly from one tall tree to another.
ex.zh: 这只瘦瘦的灰猴子敏捷地从一棵大树爬到另一棵树上。

tip: “thin”表示人物或动物“瘦的”，注意“th”要咬舌清读，别读成/s/。

ex.en: A tall tree shades our garden in the afternoon.
ex.zh: 下午，一棵高大的树为我们的花园遮阴。

ex.en: Tall buildings can accommodate more residents, but careful planning is needed to preserve sunlight and public space.
ex.zh: 高层建筑可以容纳更多居民，但需要精心规划，以保留阳光和公共空间。

tip: 人、树、楼通常用tall；山通常用high。

senses.en: not tall in height; low from top to bottom

ex.en: My little brother is short, so he stands first.
ex.zh: 我弟弟个子矮，所以他排在队伍最前面。

ex.en: Beside the tall pine tree, there grows a short green apple tree.
ex.zh: 在高高的松树旁边，长着一棵矮矮的绿色苹果树。

col: a short boy｜一个矮个子男孩
tip: “short”形容身高时表示“矮的”，它的反义词是“tall（高的）”。

ex.en: Our old dog sleeps beside the warm kitchen stove.
ex.zh: 我们家的老狗睡在温暖的厨房炉子旁。

ex.en: Preserving old buildings can protect cultural heritage while attracting visitors and supporting the local economy.
ex.zh: 保护古老建筑既能保护文化遗产，也能吸引游客并支持当地经济。

tip: an old friend通常指相识已久，不一定年纪大。

ex.en: A young kitten fell asleep inside my empty shoe.
ex.zh: 一只小猫在我空着的鞋子里睡着了。

ex.en: Young people need affordable housing and stable employment to build independent lives in large cities.
ex.zh: 年轻人需要负担得起的住房和稳定的工作，才能在大城市独立生活。

tip: the young指年轻人群体；动物的幼崽也可用young。

ex.en: We need a big bag for all these towels.
ex.zh: 我们需要一个大袋子来装所有这些毛巾。

ex.en: Public transport can make a big difference to air quality in rapidly growing cities.
ex.zh: 公共交通能显著改善快速发展城市的空气质量。

tip: big较口语；正式写作可按语境用large或major。

ex.en: Our small kitchen has room for only two chairs.
ex.zh: 我们的小厨房只能放下两把椅子。

ex.en: Even small improvements in home insulation can reduce energy consumption and lower household bills.
ex.zh: 即使对住宅保温做出小幅改善，也能减少能源消耗并降低家庭开支。

tip: 数量少可说a small number of，不能说small people。

ex.en: That cute kitten is sleeping inside my slipper.
ex.zh: 那只可爱的小猫正睡在我的拖鞋里。

ex.en: Advertisements often feature cute animals to attract attention and create positive feelings towards a product.
ex.zh: 广告常用可爱的动物吸引注意，让人们对产品产生好感。

tip: 偏口语，常形容婴儿、小动物或讨喜的外表。

ex.en: I met an old friend at the market yesterday.
ex.zh: 我昨天在市场遇到了一位老朋友。

ex.en: Maintaining close friendships can improve mental wellbeing, as friends often provide emotional support during difficult periods.
ex.zh: 维持亲密友谊可以改善心理健康，因为朋友常在困难时期提供情感支持。

col: keep in touch with friends｜与朋友保持联系
tip: “与某人交朋友”用make friends with，friends用复数。

ex.en: My classmate lent me a pencil before the lesson.
ex.zh: 上课前，我的同班同学借给我一支铅笔。

ex.en: Working with classmates on group projects can help students develop communication and problem-solving skills.
ex.zh: 与同班同学合作完成小组项目可以帮助学生培养沟通和解决问题的能力。

col: a former classmate｜以前的同班同学
help a classmate｜帮助同班同学
tip: classmate指同班同学，schoolmate指同校同学。

ex.en: The girl carefully carried her kitten into the house.
ex.zh: 那个女孩小心翼翼地把小猫抱进屋里。

ex.en: Ensuring that every girl can attend school is essential for reducing inequality and supporting economic development.
ex.zh: 确保每个女孩都能上学，对于减少不平等和促进经济发展至关重要。

tip: 成年女性正式称woman；girl不直接表示女朋友。
